login.title: Sign in to Aegis
login.subtitle: Operator credentials for the control panel.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Operational overview of the Aegis panel.
dashboard.hostsDesc: Endpoints bundled as products for end users.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.subtitle: BYO servers running the VPN core (sing-box).
nodes.createDescription: Provide the SSH endpoint the panel will use to reach the node. The node's own registration is a separate step in the agent flow.
nodes.editDescription: Update the node's metadata. The agent will pick up the change on its next heartbeat.
nodes.name: Name
nodes.provisionAfterCreateHint: The panel will SSH into the node and install the agent in the same step. Uncheck to register the node only and provision later from the row menu.
nodes.createdProvisionFailedHint: The node is in `new` state. Retry provisioning from the row menu (Provision action).
nodes.provisionDescription: Install the agent on a remote node. The panel connects over SSH, uploads the agent binary, writes the systemd unit, and verifies the service is active.
nodes.provisionOnlyNew: Only nodes in `new` or `offline` state can be provisioned.
nodes.authMethodHint: Pick how the panel authenticates to the node. The 'Stored panel key' option is only available for re-provisions.
nodes.authMethodPassword: SSH password (paste the VPS root password)
nodes.authMethodStored: Stored panel key (re-use the panel's own key)
nodes.authMethodStoredDisabledTitle: Available only for re-provisions (a node that was previously installed).
nodes.sshPrivateKeyHint: PEM-encoded, no passphrase. The panel does not store this.
nodes.sshPasswordHint: The VPS root password for first-time auth. The panel does not store this — the install is the only consumer, then the agent switches to bearer-token auth.
nodes.tofuPolicyHint: reject: paste the SHA256 fingerprint. accept-and-append: pin the key on first contact.
nodes.expectedFingerprintHint: Required when the policy is "Reject". Get it with `ssh-keyscan -t ssh-ed25519 HOST | ssh-keygen -lf -`.
nodes.rotateDescription: Generate a fresh ed25519 keypair, push the public half to the node's authorized_keys, and store the encrypted private half on the panel. The next re-provision on this node decrypts and reuses the new key — the v0.8.x 'auto-deploy' experience becomes available retroactively on v0.3.0..v0.7.x nodes. This is the UI mirror of the v0.8.3 `aegis admin node rotate-panel-key` CLI.
nodes.rotateSshPrivateKeyHint: PEM, no passphrase. The panel uses this to SSH into the node, then discards it. The key must already be in the node's authorized_keys (i.e. this is the key you used to install the node).
nodes.rotateResultHelp: The new public key is now in the node's authorized_keys. The next re-provision on this node uses the panel's own key (no operator input required).
nodes.rotateFailed: Could not rotate the panel key
nodes.inspectDescription: Read-side mirror of the v0.8.1 persistent key feature. The panel decrypts `nodes.ssh_private_key_ciphertext` via the age envelope, derives the public-key line + SHA-256 fingerprint, and returns the public surface. The private key never leaves the panel process. The read is recorded in the audit log as `node.stored-key.read`.
nodes.inspectNoKey: This node has no stored panel key yet.
nodes.inspectNoKeyHint: The first password-based install (v0.8.1+) generates one; the v0.8.3 CLI `aegis admin node rotate-panel-key <node-uuid>` back-fills legacy v0.3.0..v0.7.x nodes.
nodes.inspectSurfaceHelp: The private key stays in the panel process; only the public surface is shown. Compare the SHA256 fingerprint against `ssh-keygen -lf /etc/aegis/authorized_keys` on the node to verify the key is what the panel has on file.
nodes.inspectFailed: Could not load the stored key
nodes.refreshDescription: Operator-side recovery path for the agent bearer. The panel decrypts the stored panel SSH key, SSHes into the node, reads /etc/aegis/agent.env, parses AEGIS_AGENT_BEARER, and updates nodes.agent_bearer. Use this when the agent's bearer is out of sync with the panel (e.g. after a manual agent restart that wiped /etc/aegis/agent.env).
nodes.refreshResultHelp: The new bearer is what the panel will use for subsequent POST /v1/apply calls. You can verify it on the node by running `cat /etc/aegis/agent.env` — the AEGIS_AGENT_BEARER line should match. The fingerprint proves the refresh used the panel key the panel has on file.
nodes.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the agent bearer

inbounds.title: Inbounds
inbounds.subtitle: Per-node protocol listeners (VLESS / Hysteria 2 / Shadowsocks / Trojan).
inbounds.name: Name
inbounds.createDescription: Register a protocol listener on a node. The agent picks the change up on its next heartbeat and binds the port (plus any extra Listen ports).
inbounds.editDescription: Update the inbound's parameters. The agent re-renders the sing-box config on the next heartbeat.
inbounds.listenHint: Bind address. Default `::` (IPv6 wildcard). Use 0.0.0.0 for IPv4-only, or a specific IP literal.
inbounds.listenPortsHint: One port per line (1-65535, max 16). Optional. The subscription renderer picks one at random per fetch (defeats per-port DPI correlation).
inbounds.paramsHint: Protocol-specific configuration. Free-form JSON. The sing-box provider validates the shape at render time.

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.subtitle: Bundles of endpoints visible to end users as products.
hosts.createDescription: A host is a bundle of endpoints that the subscription service renders as one or more URLs. Direct hosts carry exactly one endpoint; balancer hosts need two or more plus a strategy.
hosts.editDescription: Update the host's metadata, endpoint list, and (for balancer hosts) the strategy. The agent picks up the change on its next heartbeat.
hosts.displayNameHint: Optional friendly name shown in subscription URLs (max 128 chars).
hosts.priorityHint: Lower = rendered first in the subscription. 0-1000, default 50.
hosts.endpointsHint: Each endpoint pairs a node with one of its inbounds. Direct hosts: 1 endpoint. Balancer hosts: 2+ endpoints.
hosts.addressHint: One per line (max 8). Leave blank to use the inbound's listen address.
hosts.portHint: Leave blank to use the inbound's listen port.

errors.directEndpointCount: Direct hosts must have exactly one endpoint
errors.balancerEndpointCount: Balancer hosts must have at least two endpoints

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: End-user VPN accounts.
users.createDescription: The panel generates a fresh sub_token. Hand the token to the user so they can paste it into a VPN client.
users.editDescription: Update username, device limit, traffic limit, or status. Saving rotates the row; the sub_token is preserved unless you click "Rotate token".
users.usernameHint: 3-32 chars, lowercase letters, digits, underscores, dashes
users.usernameMinLength: Username must be at least 3 characters
users.usernameMaxLength: Username must be at most 32 characters
users.usernameInvalidChars: Username may contain only lowercase letters, digits, underscores, and dashes
users.deleteFailed: Could not mark the user as deleted
users.confirmSoftDelete: Mark user "{username}" as deleted? The subscription URL will stop working for them, but the row is preserved for the audit log.
users.tokenViewDescription: This is the credential the user pastes into a VPN client. Treat it as a secret — it is shown only once after creation / rotation.
users.subscriptionUrlDescription: The full URL the user pastes into a VPN client. Built from the panel's origin, the active sub_path, and the user's sub_token. Use Copy to send it to the user, or Preview to see the rendered payload.
users.subscriptionUrlLoadFailed: Could not load the active sub_path
users.subscriptionPreviewFailed: Could not render the subscription preview

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.subtitle: Preview the rendered subscription payload for any sub_token.
subscription.previewDescription: Paste a sub_token to render the corresponding subscription URL. v0.1.0 ships preview only; per-user management lands in v0.2.
subscription.resultDescription: The panel's response for the requested token + format.
subscription.qrAlt: QR code for the subscription URL

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Operator-level settings.
settings.activePathDescription: The current URL prefix for the subscription endpoint. Empty = the documented /api/v1/sub/<token> path; non-empty = a rotated secret prefix that hides the subscription endpoint from URL-scraping bots.
settings.rotateDescription: Pick a fresh random sub_path. Existing subscribers on the old path will stop working immediately (or after the optional grace window).
settings.rotateRandom: Rotate to a fresh random sub_path
settings.explicitDescription: Pick a memorable sub_path yourself. Useful when the operator wants a recognizable prefix (e.g. "aegis-prod-2026").
settings.explicitHint: 4-64 characters, lowercase letters, digits, dashes only.
settings.warningDescription: Rotating the sub_path breaks every existing subscriber's URL. Subscribers must re-import the new URL on every device. The default empty sub_path (no rotation) keeps the documented /api/v1/sub/<token> path.
settings.confirmReset: Reset to the default empty sub_path? Existing subscribers on the rotated path will stop working.
settings.loadFailed: Could not load the active sub_path
settings.pathMinLength: Sub_path must be at least 4 characters
settings.pathMaxLength: Sub_path must be at most 64 characters
settings.pathInvalidChars: Sub_path may contain only lowercase letters, digits, and dashes

audits.title: Audit log
audits.subtitle: Every mutating operator action, with actor + IP + before/after.
audits.filterDescription: All fields are optional. Empty filters return the most recent 100 entries.
audits.loadFailed: Could not load the audit log
audits.detailLoadFailed: Could not load the audit entry
audits.detailDescription: The list view elides the before/after JSONB blobs. This dialog re-fetches the full row from GET /api/v1/audits/{id}.
audits.noDiff: No before/after diff was recorded for this entry.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: Tariff ladder the operator sells. Every user points at one plan via users.plan_id.
plans.name: Name
plans.empty: No plans yet. Click “New plan” to add one.
plans.confirmDelete: Delete this plan? Users on this plan will lose access to its host pools.

backups.title: Backups
backups.subtitle: Panel Postgres snapshots. Trigger on demand, keep a retention window, download the dump.
backups.createHint: Spawn a new pg_dump subprocess and stream it to a dump file. Single-flight — only one backup runs at a time.
backups.createAlreadyRunning: Another backup is already in progress
backups.loadFailed: Could not load the backup list
backups.confirmDelete: Delete backup "{id}"? This removes the dump file and the sidecar — the row is removed from the index too.
backups.empty: No backups yet. Click “Create backup” to start one.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your operator identity + security settings.
profile.identityDescription: Your operator record, as it sits in the admins table.
profile.securityDescription: Rotate the password used to sign in.
profile.changePasswordDescription: The current password is verified to defend against a stolen access token. The new password is hashed with argon2id before it is persisted.
profile.newPasswordHint: At least 8 characters. Must differ from the current one.
profile.newMustDiffer: The new password must differ from the current one
profile.passwordsDoNotMatch: The new passwords do not match

webhooks.title: Outgoing webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: Operator-configured HTTP targets with HMAC-SHA256 signing, retry, and a dead-letter queue.
webhooks.createDescription: Configure a new outgoing-webhook target. The server returns the HMAC secret verbatim in the response — copy it to your receiver before dismissing.
webhooks.editDescription: Patch the endpoint. Leave the secret field empty to keep the current value; set a new value to rotate it.
webhooks.deleteDescription: This hard-deletes the endpoint and its delivery history. DLQ rows are kept (the endpoint id is a logical reference).
webhooks.secretCopyHint: Copy this to your receiver now. Subsequent reads redact the secret to ***.
webhooks.deliveriesDescription: Every POST attempt the dispatcher made to this endpoint, newest first.
webhooks.dlqDescription: Deliveries that exhausted the retry budget. Replay them once the receiver is healthy again.

field.secretHelp: 16-256 chars, used to sign the X-Aegis-Signature header.
field.secretEditHelp: Leave empty to keep the current secret; set a new value to rotate.
field.eventsHelp: Empty = subscribe to every event type.

eventsPicker.heading: Pick the events this endpoint should receive

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.subtitle: Per-(user, inbound) sing-box credentials. One row per (user, inbound) pair; rotate via the row menu.
credentials.searchPlaceholder: Search by user, inbound, or value…
credentials.createDescription: Add a new per-(user, inbound) credential. The (user, inbound) pair must be unique.
credentials.rotateDescription: Replace the credential value. The (user, inbound) pair is fixed by the existing row.
credentials.deleteDescription: This hard-deletes the credential. The (user, inbound) pair can be re-created via the New credential form.

field.credentialValueHelp: 1-512 chars. The sing-box renderer validates the per-protocol shape.

inboundTemplates.subtitle: Reusable named protocol configurations assigned to inbounds.
inboundTemplates.name: Name
inboundTemplates.paramsHint: Free-form JSON. The sing-box provider validates the per-protocol shape.
inboundTemplates.createDescription: Create a named, reusable protocol configuration. The renderer reads `params` from this row for every inbound that points at it.
inboundTemplates.deleteDescription: Delete "{name}"? Any inbound that points at this template will fall back to its inline `params`. This cannot be undone.
inboundTemplates.assignToInboundHint: When set, the sing-box renderer reads `params` from the template instead of this inbound's inline `params`. Protocol must match.
